svg.text: Cross-layer KV sharing: which layer's cache does each layer read?
Example config (made up) · 8 main layers · a source owns the cache, its consumers read it
kv_source_layer_ids [1,3,5,6] index_k sources = kv sources (loader default) index_source_layer_ids [1,2,3,5,6]
Which layer is the source of each value?
"own" = the layer computes and stores the value. "← n" = the layer reads the value of layer n.
Rules (checked at start-up): a segment is one source and the layers right after it. Each top-k segment lies inside one
index-K segment, and each index-K segment inside one KV segment. Layer 5 is the first YOCO consumer, so it must be a KV source.
Layer 0 has ratio 0: it has no compressed KV and no indexer. Every layer keeps its own SWA ring and its own query.
How does a value get from layer 3 to layer 4 in one forward?
Caches: the consumer gets the same tensor view. Per-step values: they go through one CrossLayerRuntime object.
Layer 3: KV, index-K and index source
prefill: loads KV into a BF16 buffer
Layer 4 still computes its own query, its own SWA KV and its own attention output.
Simplified: the candidate-block map (layer_candidate_source_map) is not shown. Source ids and ratios are example values;
the real ones come from the checkpoint's config.json and are not in the repo.
